definition: The multi-timeframe DNA structure for one symbol, grouped into Direction / Campaign / Confirmation / Timing / Right-now tiers.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not call it "trend" — trend is a single-TF slope, campaign is the multi-TF structure.

definition: Upper-tier structure that supports holding a position. A statement about structure, not a directional promise.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not say "bullish" — implies a directional call; "constructive" is structural.

definition: Campaign tier actively building on IGNITION / EXPANSION / ADD / STRONG START events.
deprecated_or_forbidden: None

definition: Rebuilding after a prior failure, signalled by RELOAD / RECOVERY / RECOVERY WATCH.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not call it "recovered" — repair is unconfirmed until the next event holds.

definition: Losing momentum, signalled by PEAK / PREMIUM / MANAGE or an exhaustion warning.
deprecated_or_forbidden: None

definition: Upper-tier FAIL events (FAIL / FAILED / FAIL TEST / MODERATE FAIL / STRONG FAIL / CATASTROPHIC FAIL).
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not soften to "weak" — broken means a failure event fired on a deciding tier.

definition: No dominant reading: WAIT, missing data, or conflicting evidence across tiers.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not read "quiet" as "safe" — absence of a signal is not an all-clear.

definition: Whether an option strike is in or out of the money relative to the underlying price.
deprecated_or_forbidden: In prose write "in the money" / "out of the money", not "ITM" / "OTM".

definition: Days remaining until the option contract expires.
deprecated_or_forbidden: None

definition: Loss of option value as expiration approaches. Described qualitatively, never quantified.
deprecated_or_forbidden: FORBID "theta" and any Greek — the free data plan provides no trustworthy Greeks.

definition: Holding total_return_pct >= 0.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not infer future profit from being currently profitable.

definition: Holding total_return_pct < 0.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not infer recovery from a current loss.

definition: Weighted avg_cost per share or contract, from the valuation payload.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not say "entry" when you mean avg_cost — entry (first_entry) is a timestamp.

definition: current_price: live webhook close if present, else Massive daily close.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not call it a live quote — it is the freshest recorded close.

definition: For options: strike plus (call) or minus (put) avg_cost.
deprecated_or_forbidden: None

definition: first_entry timestamp the position or instrument was opened.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not confuse first_entry (timestamp) with avg_cost (price).

definition: active_stop: DNA Trade Box stop level on the active timeframe.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not invent a stop if active_stop is null.

definition: active_target: DNA Trade Box target level on the active timeframe.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not present active_target as a predicted price.

definition: Keep the position unchanged; no threshold crossed.
deprecated_or_forbidden: None

definition: Take no action and await the next DNA event or confirmation.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Distinct from hold: wait implies an open decision is pending.

definition: Reduce downside risk without a full exit (tighten stop, or a protective leg).
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not call it a "hedge" unless a protective leg is actually held.

definition: Scale down size to lock partial gains or cut partial losses.
deprecated_or_forbidden: None

definition: Exit the holding; optionally remain out until structure repairs.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not imply re-entry timing.

definition: Add size only after the next event (ADD / MANAGE) confirms the signal.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Forbid adding on a single unconfirmed reading.

definition: Change strike or expiry of an option to stay in a constructive campaign.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Never prescribe a roll without chain evidence; strike/expiry only, no premium sizing.

definition: No directional action; track DTE pressure on the option.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Do not quantify decay (no Greeks).

canonical: ignition / reload / add / manage / peak / fail
definition: Distinctive DNA event names. Ignition=campaign start, Reload=recovery, Add=continuation, Manage=overextended, Peak=topping, Fail=breakdown.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Retain verbatim only when referring to an actual engine event; do not genericise.

definition: A position with more than one option leg. Future-ready: not yet represented in the manual positions model.
deprecated_or_forbidden: Mark as future-ready; do not fabricate legs or net Greeks.
